pistol_service.note: Wrok's blued 1911 base skin (1,311 tris; steel metallic 1 / roughness 0.3 gets a small torch-hall reflection; ivory grips). If it does not load, "fallback" (the first PS2 1911) is used, then the voxel pistol. Swap models by changing only "file"; grip, slide and red-dot numbers fit both 1911s (same anchors).

rifle.note: Wrok's low-poly AK (blued steel, weathered wood; steel uses the locked 1911 sheen: tint 1.3, env 1.7). Replaces the Gothic Rifle. If it does not load, the voxel rifle stays. mag_well is the reload pivot; the moving part is bolt_carrier.

smg_tactical.note: Wrok's low-poly MP5 (blued steel, worn black polymer; same locked 1911 steel sheen). Replaces the Tactical SMG. If it does not load, the voxel SMG stays. mag_well is the reload pivot; the moving part is cocking_handle.

smg_compact.note: Wrok's low-poly Uzi (blued steel, worn black polymer; same locked 1911 steel sheen). Replaces the Compact SMG. If it does not load, the voxel SMG stays. mag_well is the reload pivot; the moving part is top_cover.

rifle_m4.note: Wrok's low-poly M4 Carbine (blued steel, worn black polymer; same locked 1911 steel sheen: tint 1.3, env 1.7). New rifle slot, not a replacement. If the GLB does not load, the Gothic Rifle voxel is used. mag_well is the reload pivot; the moving part is charging_handle; optic_mount is the ADS anchor.

crimson_halls.where: every floor (Wrok's v2 textures on the kit when they load; ?voxelwalls keeps the old painted walls)
